```{r}
library(Biostrings)
```

```{r}
file_str <- "rosalind_prot.txt"
RNA_str <- readr::read_file(file_str)
```

```{r}
rstring <- RNAString(RNA_str)
tnew <- translate(rstring)
tnew
```

```{r}
cat(as.character(tnew), file = "output.txt")
```
